scheme_name: Chief Minister's Building and Other Construction Workers Urban Housing Scheme (MPBOCWWB)
other_conditions: Must have engaged in any building or other construction work for at least 90 days during the preceding 12 months.
Must have a valid identity card and be registered as a beneficiary under the Act before the scheme’s Gazette publication.
Workers registered after Gazette publication become eligible for benefits after one year from the registration date.
Beneficiaries must be registered under the Act to qualify for the scheme.
benefits_summary: Provides a one-time assistance of ₹1,00,000 to eligible construction workers.
